scoring.exact_recall: normalized case-insensitive exact string or exact scalar; numeric questions use JSON numbers; enum answers are constrained by schema
scoring.state: checkpoint expected-state facts compared exactly by declared slot; unrecorded facts are wrong
scoring.critical: checkpoint misses for dates, budgets, exclusions, cancellation/task status, incident identifiers, permissions, and safety limits
scoring.unsupported: non-null incorrect answer at a labeled checkpoint
scoring.confidence: Brier score for present facts only; missing facts counted separately
